_about: Source data for the six concept designs. scripts/build-images.py makes the web images from design-masters/; scripts/build-pages.mjs builds the model pages, the homepage chapters and public/models/manifest.json from this file. Public copy only: no internal hardware, software or implementation details. The shared product summary is in product-overview.json.

models.name: Arch
models.tagline: An arch for a side table.
models.intro: An upright design with a curved top, shown beside a sofa or chair.
models.setting: Side table in the living room

lifestyle.title: Beside your favourite chair.
lifestyle.text: On a dark round side table, next to the morning's magazine. Small enough to share the space with a cup of chai.

detail.title: A crown with fine vents.
detail.text: The curve of the crown, the slim vents along its top and the outlined Synkurl mark.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Arch concept in Blush Pink: a dusty pink, arch-shaped device on a pale grey backdrop, with vent slots across its curved top, a seam sweeping around its sides, a thin white outline of the Synkurl mark in a circle, three small status lights and a dark slatted base.
images.studio-matte-black: The Arch concept in Matte Black: a low-sheen black, arch-shaped device on a pale grey backdrop, with vent slots across its curved top, a seam sweeping around its sides, a thin champagne outline of the Synkurl mark in a circle, three small status lights and a slatted base.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Arch concept in Dusk Violet: a muted violet, arch-shaped device on a pale grey backdrop, with vent slots across its curved top, a seam sweeping around its sides, a thin champagne outline of the Synkurl mark in a circle, three small status lights and a dark slatted base.
images.studio-rose-gold: The Arch concept in Rose Gold: a warm, softly reflective rose gold, arch-shaped device on a pale grey backdrop, with vent slots across its curved top, a seam sweeping around its sides, a subtle tone-on-tone Synkurl mark in a circle, three status lights and a dark slatted base.
images.lifestyle: The Arch concept in Dusk Violet on a round dark-wood side table beside a beige fabric armchair, next to a closed magazine lying flat. Its vent slots, outlined Synkurl mark and three status lights are visible; a wooden floor, rug and sunlit window sit behind.
images.detail: Close-up of the Arch concept in Dusk Violet, showing the rounded top with a row of vent slots, the fine textured surface, a seam curving across the side, and part of the thin champagne outline of the Synkurl mark in a circle.

models.name: Dome
models.tagline: A low dome for a coffee table.
models.intro: A low, rounded design, shown on a living-room table.
models.setting: Limestone table in a living room

lifestyle.title: On the coffee table.
lifestyle.text: On a pale limestone table, beside a soft green sofa. Seen from above, it reads like a polished pebble.

detail.title: A ring of vents on top.
detail.text: The domed top, its circle of vents around the Synkurl mark, and the fine seam where the lid meets the base.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Dome concept in Blush Pink: a low, dusty-pink dome on a slim round base against a pale studio backdrop. Fine vents ring the outlined Synkurl mark on top; three small status lights sit above a row of vent slots.
images.studio-matte-black: The Dome concept in Matte Black: a low, rounded black dome on a slim round base against a pale studio backdrop. Fine vents ring the outlined Synkurl mark, lit warm amber, on top; three small status lights sit above a row of vent slots.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Dome concept in Dusk Violet: a low, muted purple dome on a slim round base against a pale studio backdrop. Fine vents ring the outlined Synkurl mark on top; three small status lights sit above a row of vent slots.
images.lifestyle: The Dome concept in Rose Gold on an oval, pitted stone coffee table in a sunlit living room, in front of a green woven sofa, with a woven rug and wooden floor below. Its outlined Synkurl mark glows softly; three small status lights show on the base.
images.detail: Close-up of the Dome concept in Rose Gold, showing the outlined Synkurl mark inside a ring of fine vents on top, the seam where the dome meets its base, and three small status lights above a row of vent slots.

models.name: Spine
models.tagline: A slim design for a bookshelf.
models.intro: A tall, narrow design, shown standing beside books.

lifestyle.title: Among the books.
lifestyle.text: On a dark oak bookshelf, between cloth-bound books, with space to breathe on either side.

detail.title: A cap of fine perforations.
detail.text: The perforated top cap, its gently shaped lip and the seam that runs around it.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Spine concept in Blush Pink, a slim upright tower with a perforated top grille and a top cap with a gently scooped front edge, seen at a three-quarter angle on grey. A glowing outlined Synkurl mark sits above three small status lights and a slotted base vent.
images.studio-matte-black: The Spine concept in Matte Black, a slim upright tower with a perforated top grille and a top cap with a gently scooped front edge, seen at a three-quarter angle on grey. A glowing outlined Synkurl mark sits above three small status lights and a slotted base vent.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Spine concept in Dusk Violet, a slim upright tower with a perforated top grille and a top cap with a gently scooped front edge, seen at a three-quarter angle on grey. A glowing outlined Synkurl mark sits above three small status lights and a slotted base vent.
images.studio-rose-gold: The Spine concept in Rose Gold, a slim upright tower with a soft metallic sheen, a perforated top grille and a gently scooped top cap, seen at a three-quarter angle on grey. A glowing outlined Synkurl mark sits above three small status lights and a slotted base vent.
images.lifestyle: The Spine concept in Blush Pink stands upright on a dark wooden bookshelf in warm sunlight, between plain cloth-bound books and a framed abstract print. Its glowing outlined Synkurl mark, three small status lights and slotted base vent face the viewer.
images.detail: Close-up of the Spine concept in Blush Pink, looking down at its top: an evenly perforated grille framed by a rounded rim, and a separate top cap whose front edge curves gently inward. Part of the glowing outlined Synkurl mark shows on the front below.

models.name: Stack
models.tagline: A layered design for a shelf.
models.intro: A design with three visible layers, shown on a shelf near a router.

lifestyle.title: Near the router.
lifestyle.text: On a pale painted shelf in a home work corner, with the Wi-Fi router a little way along and a folded letter nearby.

detail.title: Three tiers, fine vents.
detail.text: The rounded edges of the three tiers and the fine vent bands between them.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Stack concept in Blush Pink, a soft dusty-pink satin finish: three rounded rectangular tiers with dark perforated vent bands between them and a vented base. The outlined Synkurl mark sits on top; three small status lights glow on the front.
images.studio-matte-black: The Stack concept in Matte Black, a low-sheen black finish: three rounded rectangular tiers with perforated vent bands between them and a vented base. The outlined Synkurl mark sits on top; three small status lights glow on the front.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Stack concept in Dusk Violet, a muted deep purple finish: three rounded rectangular tiers with dark perforated vent bands between them and a vented base. The outlined Synkurl mark sits on top; three small status lights glow on the front.
images.studio-rose-gold: The Stack concept in Rose Gold, a warm pink-champagne metallic finish with soft highlights along its edges: three rounded rectangular tiers with dark perforated vent bands between them. The outlined Synkurl mark sits on top; three small status lights glow on the front.
images.lifestyle: The Stack concept in Matte Black on a painted off-white shelf against a textured plaster wall, the Synkurl mark on top and three status lights glowing. A plain white router stands behind it to the right; folded white paper lies in the foreground.
images.detail: Close-up of the Stack concept in Matte Black: the rounded front-right corner of its three stacked tiers, with fine perforated vent bands between them. Three status lights glow white, blue and amber; the Synkurl mark is partly visible at the top.

models.name: Box
models.tagline: A low box for the TV table.
models.intro: A low, square design with rounded corners, shown below a TV.

lifestyle.title: Below the TV.
lifestyle.text: On a walnut media console under the television, next to the tray where the remote lives.

detail.title: Two bands of vents.
detail.text: A rounded front corner, the vent band below the lid and the one above the base, with three small lights between.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Box concept in Blush Pink: a low, square device with a softly rounded lid bearing the outlined Synkurl mark. Rows of black vent slots run above and below the pink front band, which shows three glowing status lights.
images.studio-matte-black: The Box concept in Matte Black: a low, square device with a softly rounded lid bearing the outlined Synkurl mark in a pale line. Vent slots run above and below the black front band, which shows three glowing status lights.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Box concept in Dusk Violet: a low, square device with a softly rounded, muted purple lid bearing the outlined Synkurl mark. Black vent slots run above and below the violet front band, which shows three glowing status lights.
images.studio-rose-gold: The Box concept in Rose Gold: a low, square device with a rounded lid in a warm pink-champagne sheen, bearing the outlined Synkurl mark. Black vent slots run above and below the front band, which shows three glowing status lights.
images.lifestyle: The Box concept in Matte Black sits on a polished wooden sideboard beneath a wall-mounted dark screen, its three status lights glowing. Late sunlight warms the textured white wall, and a dark stone tray holding a remote rests to the right.
images.detail: Close-up of the Box concept in Matte Black: three status lights glow white, pale blue-green and amber, between rows of vent slots. Part of the outlined Synkurl mark shows on the rounded lid above.

models.name: Box Plus
models.tagline: A rounded box for a shelf.
models.intro: A rounded design with a curved lid. Plus is its design name.

lifestyle.title: On an open shelf.
lifestyle.text: On its own open oak shelf in a light kitchen, with plenty of space around it.

detail.title: A softly curved side.
detail.text: The broad curve of the sidewall, the fine vent band beneath the lid and the recessed, vented base.

images.studio-blush-pink: The Box Plus concept in Blush Pink: a low square box in a dusty pink with rounded corners and a gently domed lid showing the outlined Synkurl mark. Small vent slots ring the lid seam; three lights glow on the front above a ribbed black base.
images.studio-matte-black: The Box Plus concept in Matte Black: a low square box with rounded corners and a gently domed lid showing the Synkurl mark in a pale outline. Small vent slots ring the lid seam; three lights glow on the front above a ribbed base.
images.studio-dusk-violet: The Box Plus concept in Dusk Violet: a low square box in a muted purple with rounded corners and a gently domed lid showing the outlined Synkurl mark. Small vent slots ring the lid seam; three lights glow on the front above a ribbed black base.
images.studio-rose-gold: The Box Plus concept in Rose Gold: a low square box with a warm, softly reflective metallic-look finish, rounded corners and a gently domed lid showing the outlined Synkurl mark. Small vent slots ring the lid seam; three front lights glow above a ribbed black base.
images.lifestyle: The Box Plus concept in Dusk Violet sits on a wooden floating shelf above a stainless-steel refrigerator in a sunlit kitchen, three front lights glowing. Pale cabinets, a leafy window, a chopping board and a pot of wooden spoons and a whisk complete the scene.
images.detail: Close-up of the Box Plus concept in Dusk Violet, showing a rounded front corner in muted purple. Small vent slots ring the lid seam, three lights glow, and a ribbed black base runs beneath.
